walk.pace_note: a ten-minute walk at a normal pace is about 800 m; fifteen minutes about 1.2 km

honesty.not_a_score: this is not Walk Score(R) and no relationship with it is claimed or implied.
honesty.straight_line: distance here is straight-line between coordinates, not a street-network walk: a freeway, a rail cut, a canal or a gated block makes the real walk longer, sometimes impossibly longer. Walk the block before you believe the number.
honesty.what_it_counts: the Academy draws the bands around a campus and reports which real anchors - RECORDED where a sibling source exists to cross-check against, AUTHORED where none does - fall inside them. It counts no shops, because this bundle holds no shop records - the classes above are carried so the map can say what a walkable measure would have to count.
